'''A Jedi''' was the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] of [[Dazh Ranos]], a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who herself became a Master by time of [[War against Zakuul]]. While speaking to the [[Alliance Commander]] Ranos wondered what her former Master would have to say about her joining the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|The Light Triumphant|Odessen}}</ref>
